## Gorilla Bear (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 N Large magical beast  

**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +9  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 11, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +5 natural, –1 size)  

**hp** 60 (4d10+16 plus 4)  

**Fort** +8; **Ref** +6; **Will** +2  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  

**Melee** 2 claws +8 (1d8+5 plus grab), bite +8 (1d8+5)  

**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  

**Special Attacks** constrict (1d8+5)  

**Statistics**

  **Str** 20, **Dex** 15, **Con** 18, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 7  

**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +10 (+14 grapple); **CMD** 22 (26 vs. trip)  

**Feats** Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness  

**Skills** Climb +11, Perception +9, Swim +11; **Racial Modifiers** +2 Climb, +2 Swim

  

**Ecology**

 **Environment** warm forests  

**Organization** solitary, pair, or pack (3–6)  

**Treasure** none
